name: Books-A-Million Receipt
description: This receipt-style logo presents the “BOOKS·A·MILLION®” brand name in bold, uppercase lettering with centered dot separators between each word segment, printed in solid black on a white background. The typography is clean and evenly spaced, reflecting standard thermal receipt printer output. A registered trademark symbol (®) appears at the upper right of the brand name. Beneath the main logo, a secondary line displays the phrase “shop online at booksamillion.com” in smaller, lowercase text, aligned centrally. The overall format is minimal and high-contrast, consistent with POS receipt branding used in bookstore retail environments.
